explanationMd: Use (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² with a = 2x and b = 3. This gives 4x² − 12x + 9. Multiplying the two identical binomials directly confirms the doubled cross term.

distractorRationale.d: This confuses a square with a difference-of-squares product.
distractorRationale.a: This fails to square the coefficient two correctly.
distractorRationale.c: This includes only one of the two cross products.
